six_common_misreadings.reality: Under current data, current capital size (retail 10-20U), current automation model, 5/5 Solana AMM protocols reject. Large capital + professional market making + hedging may still have positive EV. New protocols or EVM-side may differ. Out of scope of this study.

Retail 10-20U 2000 USD LP is different market from institutional LP. Institutional has MEV income, bribe, incentive farming, hedging tools, lower cost basis. 5/5 reject is retail model, not institutional model.

lpbot code retains value: EVM V3 pipeline, BSC QuoterV2 fix, Base wallet dry-run, Solana RPC registry, 5 Solana AMM connectors, EV framework, artifact index, verdict discipline, safety gates, hard-disable executor. All reusable for other research (scanner, dashboard, hedging tool).

5 connectors 100% SDK decode verified on mainnet. Real engineering work, documented and tested. Usable as SDK integration templates, hedging tool data source, LP monitoring data source, scanner/dashboard data source.

STOP_LP_RESEARCH_NOW is current state, not permanent. Reopen conditions: real fee accrual / actual position tokenId data, protocol incentives / bribe, stable high-fee velocity pool, lower cost link, paid RPC / indexer, user-provided specific pool or strategy, non-standard LP strategies (incentive farming, delta-hedged, JIT, etc.). Reopen != direct live trading; still requires read-only → preflight → dry-run → manual approval.
STOP_LP_RESEARCH_NOW specifically means: do not continue auto-probe under current data, current capital, current model. Manual operator decisions are out of scope of this STOP.

keep_active: safety gates (artifact index, verdict discipline, tests)
paused: any form of unattended LP execution
exact_stopping_wording: Under current data, current capital size (retail 10-20U 2000 USD), and current automation model, do not continue auto-probe of LP.
